newsitem.title: UK: ROYAL SUN NO COMMENT ON TALK OF POLISH BUY.
newsitem.headline: ROYAL SUN NO COMMENT ON TALK OF POLISH BUY.

text.p: Britain's Royal & Sun Alliance Insurance Group Plc declined to comment on Monday on talk it is to take a stake in Polish insurer Heros SA.

A spokeman for Royal Sun confirmed that, following the signing of a development agreement with the European Bank of Reconstruction and Development (EBRD), the company was actively looking at opportunities in eastern European.
But he declined to comment on specific cases.
At the end of July Royal Sun agreed a deal with the EBRD to develop business opportunities in central and eastern Europe.
Under the terms of the three year partnership, the EBRD will invest up to 25.3 million stg in any projects the company develops in central and eastern Europe.
Royal Sun's deputy chairman Roger Taylor said then he believed there were significant business opportunities in central and eastern Europe which offered sustainable growth and future profit.
